name: 武动仙途
english_name: Wu Dong Xian Tu (Martial Path to Immortality)
english_description: A large, 46,890-file archive whose conversion originally timed out mid-transfer. It uses a custom client protocol rather than a plain-text telnet prompt: on connecting, the server issues a version challenge that the client must answer with a correctly encrypted response (or one of two built-in bypass strings), or be disconnected as an "illegal client." Account registration and character creation likewise arrive as single lines with multiple fields separated by a full-width vertical bar (║) — a design built for the game's dedicated GUI client, not a bug.
